title: optionsframe
summary: MSUI intentionally retains the build-5875 Game Menu and resizable three-page OptionsFrame shape rather than Benilla's era category-tree shell. GameMenuUiLaw continues to own independent scale, remembered size, viewport clamping and modal centering. OptionsSearchUiLaw adds Benilla's 350x22 Common-Input-Border search seat and cross-page search without altering MSUI's established presentation. Interface exposes current nameplate rows, Sticky Targeting, Lock ActionBars, Camera Following Style in Smart/Always/Never order, and Show Cloak then Show Helm. The equipment-display rows are searchable per-character server preferences rather than CVars: a pure controller compares the requested set-state against an optimistic belief, emits an empty-bodied flip only on difference, and lets the next real PLAYER_FLAGS edge overwrite that belief. No gameplay or Escape/menu scaling, remembered-size, page-geometry, protected Character presentation, or local-settings persistence behavior changed.

openItems.text: No Sound/Audio options page - the Game Menu's Sound Options button is permanently disabled ('no sound subsystem yet', a stale claim now that PlayUiSound exists) despite UI sounds being live
openItems.resolution: The Game Menu's Sound Options button is enabled and opens a live page with Enable All/Music/Ambience switches plus Master, Effects, Music and Ambience volume sliders backed by persisted AudioSettings and applied through the live audio mixer path.

openItems.text: No nameplate options rows (Benilla's Nameplates page: show friendly/enemy plates etc.)
openItems.resolution: Interface Options now exposes Player Names, NPC Names and Show Own Name rows with current Benilla's enabled defaults; the persisted ControlSettings flags gate the live nameplate candidate pass.

Every Video, Interface, and Sound options page now has a rule-seated Common-Input-Border search field with the reference whole-query/token substring scorer, page-grouped catalog results, no-result state, authored clear button, Search Results title, and click-through navigation. Search hides page-scoped Defaults while retaining MSUI's protected resizable/scaling and live-apply/cancel behavior.

openItems.text: Live-verify Options search input/clear alignment at minimum, default and enlarged remembered window sizes; placeholder/focus behavior; multi-token cross-page ordering; scroll overflow; no-result state; result navigation; and preserved live-apply, Cancel, Okay, independent scale and resize persistence.
No per-page Defaults button (only whole-quality presets)
openItems.resolution: Every options page footer has a Defaults button. ResetVisiblePageToDefaults replaces only the visible page's settings group (Video composites, Controls including nameplates, or Audio), resolves composites, and applies the result live.

openItems.text: Current Benilla's Camera page exposes the build-5875 Camera Following Style dropdown in Smart/Always/Never order, but MSUI had no persisted row and always used one hard-coded recenter behavior.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: added a searchable Camera Following Style row in the existing protected Options presentation, driven by CameraFollowLaw's reference order/labels and v10 typed settings migration. No scale, remembered-size or window geometry behavior changed.

openItems.text: Live-verify the Camera Following Style row at minimum/default/enlarged Options sizes: Smart/Always/Never order, current-value text, per-selection tooltip, search navigation, Cancel rollback, Okay persistence, page Defaults returning Smart, and unchanged independent Escape/menu and gameplay UI scaling.
Current Benilla's Interface page exposes server-owned Show Cloak and Show Helm rows, but MSUI had no in-world preference controls despite already carrying the two opcodes and PLAYER_FLAGS field.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: added searchable Show Cloak then Show Helm rows inside the existing protected Interface Options presentation. They are not persisted to settings; the optimistic set-to-flip controller sends only on a requested state change and reconciles on authoritative PLAYER_FLAGS edges. Focused/full clinical checks pass.

openItems.text: Live-verify Show Cloak then Show Helm row order, initial state after login, independent clicks, rapid repeat clicks before round-trip completion, Defaults/Cancel/Okay behavior as server-owned non-CVars, search navigation, reconnect persistence and unchanged protected Options scaling/resize/centering.
